description: Search aggregated news headlines from curated public sources: headline, URL, source, published time, author, image, short snippet and category. Use to find what is being reported on a topic. Served from a cache that refreshes about every 15 minutes, so a call never triggers a fetch; free and keyless, no credits are spent. Returns metadata only, not article text: to read an article, call alterlab_scrape on its URL. Cite results as 'News via AlterLab'.

category.description: Category, e.g. world, technology, business, science, sports, general

query.description: Text to match in headline or snippet

since.description: ISO 8601 time; only items published after it

source.description: Source id, e.g. bbc, npr, guardian-world, aljazeera

name: alterlab_news
title: Get News Headlines
